evidence.quote: The intake rota moves to fortnightly in November

observations.why: Attention sits on a scheduled November change to a specific rota and call; the present tense frames a planned future, so irrealis rather than realis.

evidence.quote: The pantry restocks any shelf when it falls below a third full.

observations.why: A generic standing rule in present tense about any shelf, with no particular event; present focus and abstract construal.

evidence.quote: Both start on the first of November.

observations.why: A specific dated start in the future, stated as planned; concrete and irrealis, matching the planned change in src-1.
